scripts.pages:dev: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply crimescenecleanerjobs --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply crimescenecleanerjobs --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:appliance: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.applianceinstalljobs.toml
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy && npx wrangler deploy --config wrangler.applianceinstalljobs.toml
